name: Controlled Access Terms
description: Provides custom field types for authority/controlled-vocabulary metadata: EDTF dates, authority links, and typed relations, plus their widgets, formatters, EDTF utilities, and Search API processors.

suggests.drupal/rdf: Provides ability to map fields to RDF.

project_description:
This module creates bundles to represent common named entities in archival description (Corporate Bodies, Families, and Persons) as well as subject terms. It also provides several field types - EDTF Dates, Authority Links, and Typed Relations - that assist in library and archival description.

 It is intended to be used in conjunction with both the ArchivesSpace/Drupal 8 Integration project and Islandora , though it has no dependencies on either and can be used on its own.

 Development is done on Github.com so please contribute PRs there rather than MRs here.
